value: A separate Duskwood quest path preserves a partial book from Sven’s farm, later connected to Jitters. Its author says he found a scythe in the rubble at Roland’s Doom; after he pulled it free, worgen attacked his companions, and he fled, losing the weapon along the way. He wonders whether his act brought the worgen, but marks that as a guess. This is a witness’s account from another chain, not a guaranteed continuation of Velinde’s investigation. Together the records narrow the loss to Duskwood, yet they do not name the Scythe’s next bearer or prove that it explains every worgen presence in the forest.
editorNote: Attribution and evidential limits remain explicit in the transcript. This claim is based on a secondary transcription; original-client comparison remains open.
